description: A clean-shaven young man in a silver muscled cuirass and a helmet with a purple and white plume runs through shallow surf on a muddy shore, holding a long spear diagonally across the frame. Behind him, a crowd of spearmen with round shields and crested helmets advances through smoke under a dark, stormy sky. On the right, a wooden warship with a painted eye on its prow sits in rough waves. The image has no visible text, border or frame, and the paint style is a dark, textured oil painting.
